name: Vegas Big and Blind 2024

venue.name: Twitchell Elementary School
venue.details: The competition will be held in the multi-purpose room.

information:
**This competition does not have typical events and is not recommended for new competitors. Please see [Cubes Canes and Joy Vegas 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesCanesJoyVegas2024) for information on a regular competition the day after.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

[This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://westcoastcubing.com) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
